To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the style-based GAN model architecture (StyleGAN), which has been shown to achieve state-of-the-art performance in data-driven unconditional image modeling, suffers from several artifacts, and that we propose changes in the model architecture and training to address these artifacts.

1) the StyleGAN architecture can be improved in several aspects, 2) this results in a significant improvement of image quality, 3) the generator can be inverted reliably and efficiently, 4) the generator can utilize the output resolution better, and 5) the model size can be increased further to improve image quality.

we improve the image quality of StyleGAN by (1) redesigning the generator normalization, (2) revisiting the progressive growing training procedure, (3) regularizing the generator to encourage a well-conditioned mapping from latent codes into images, (4) visualizing the utilization of the output resolution, (5) training larger models for additional improvements.
